purpose: Every photograph used on the Ask BeTH pages, with source, location, date, license and attribution. Photographs are illustrative only: none is evidence for any financial or condition figure.
rule: An image is used only if its reuse rights are established: a Creative Commons or public-domain license stated on its Wikimedia Commons file page, checked through the Commons API. Attribution is shown wherever the image appears. Images are the Commons 1600-pixel renditions, otherwise unmodified (cropping is by CSS only).
